central_question: Determine the asymptotic order of two extremal functions over oriented triangle-free graphs of order n: a_vec(n) = min acyclic number, and t_vec(n) = max dichromatic number. Conjecture 3: a_vec(n) = Theta(sqrt(n log n)). Conjecture 4: t_vec(n) = Theta(sqrt(n/log n)). Conjecture 3 implies Conjecture 4. Equivalent form: m(k) = min order of a k-dichromatic oriented triangle-free graph; determining t_vec is equivalent to determining m.
